text:
morgan: Heads-up — a customer just reported they accidentally downloaded an audit export that included PII. Thinking we should show a pre-download modal with a sensitive-field summary and route heavy exports to Dedicated tier (or queue them) and surface quota warning in console.

jules: ugh. do we have an API-level way to warn? i.e. return estimated_size or sensitive_field_flags before accepting export?

ravi: we could add a HEAD-like endpoint: GET /v1/audit/exports/preview with query params (query, redaction=none|partial|pii_mask) that returns estimated_bytes and sensitive_fields. API shape debate: header vs body.

tara: for console UX: modal should list top 5 sensitive fields, min role required, and a checkbox "I confirm". Don't force legal approval for small downloads.

jules: also need routing policy: exports > X MB should route to reserved/export-capacity queue with longer TTL presigned links and separate quota.

morgan: agree. default threshold maybe 50MB. Also lock export concurrency per-tenant (quota).

ravi: about redaction modes — prefer explicit `redaction=pii_mask` param. Avoid implicit server guessing.

tara: UX: show estimate time to complete (if routed) and "Will incur export quota usage" callout.

deploy-bot: export-job 1712345699 queued on export-capacity-1 for org:acme-corp, size_est=132MB :timer_clock:

jules: how do we track who downloaded? telemetry needs to emit an event on presigned link creation and on successful download with user_id, ip, bytes. retention? keep for 90 days by default.

morgan: also add console audit badge "Sensitive export" next to download button and an inline tooltip linking to redaction docs.

ravi: implementation notes: add Preview API, export allocator to routing policy layer, and telemetry events: export.preview, export.create, export.start, export.complete, export.failure.

tara: ok good. Action items: ravi implements Preview API + telemetry; jules updates routing config and quota; morgan adds console banner copy; i'll wire modal and CTA.

morgan: sgtm. anyone object to 50MB default?
jules: +1. ravi: fine. tara: fine.

morgan: i'll file a follow-up PR with API contract and wire up an internal feature flag.

jules: +1. thanks.
